<?php
/**
 * Allowlist generated by the CSP tab on 2026-10-17.
 */
add_filter( 'lkc_content_security_policy', function ( $policy ) {
	$policy['script-src'][]   = 'https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com'; // 12 violations
	$policy['style-src'][]    = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com'; // 4 violations
	$policy['font-src'][]     = 'https://fonts.gstatic.com'; // 4 violations
	$policy['connect-src'][]  = 'https://fonts.gstatic.com'; // 1 violations
	$policy['img-src'][]      = 'https://lh3.googleusercontent.com'; // 7 violations
	return $policy;
} );
